text:
Lina (Partnerships): Heads up  launching marketplace packaging effort for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need a lightweight canonical bundle we can iterate on in staging. Primary gaps: publisher IDs + admin grants, pricing/metering spec per cloud, legal sign-off on T&Cs, and final brand assets. Goal: first-stage package into staging market catalogs by next Wed.

Tom (Marketplace Ops): Short checklist from staging runbook:
- staging publisher IDs needed (I can create): aws-stg-999, gcp-stg-888, azure-stg-777
- provide list of IAM/GC identities to grant (format: email) and I'll add marketplace-admin role
- send AMI/VM images with signed manifest + sha256 (we verify checksum before upload)
Example command we use: ```sha256sum redwood-ami-2026-03-15.img```

Ellen (Legal): Please attach the draft EULA and DPIA summary. Two legal flags:
1) Telemetry: if usage logs include customer identifiers (org_id / user_id) we need a data processing addendum and region-specific retention rules
2) Trials: some clouds treat trials as "trial SKUs" which bypass billing; we should confirm whether trial entitlements are time-limited only or limited feature set as well.

Dave (Product): For pricing/metering, suggestion:
- VM/AMI images: subscription or hourly meter (meter name: redwood.inference.vm.hours)
- Bring-your-own-key/dedicated: monthly subscription SKU
- Hosted connector (if we expose it via marketplace): metered per-inference or per-token. 
I'll prepare a sample pricebook CSV with tiers (Free trial 14d / Dev tier / Prod tier) and sample billing metadata.

Cassandra (Marketing): Branding checklist: we need high-res SVG logo, 3:1 and 1:1 variants, white and dark backgrounds, and a 600x400 hero image. Also: if we show cloud co-branding, get written approval from partner marketing and keep the approval email thread in the bundle. I can fast-track approvals if you add assets to the artifacts folder.

CI-Bot: Artifacts uploaded to staging: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/staging/1767778888 - contains placeholder logos, pricebook template, packaging README, and a legal review PR template.

Tom (Marketplace Ops): Quick note on region SKUs: some clouds require region-specific images/bitmaps (GCP marketplace image per project). We'll need separate image manifests for eu-west-1 / us-west-2 vs ap-southeast-1 if we want wide availability at launch. Also, include VM image sizes we support (g4dn.xlarge, p3.2xlarge, etc.) and minimum recommended GPU drivers.

Ellen (Legal): Also confirm export-control classification of the software and whether any of the included model weights are subject to restricted export. If so, we must gate regions and add explicit restrictions in listing text.

Lina (Partnerships): Action items and owners:
- Tom: create staging publisher IDs and add Lina + Dave + Cassandra as marketplace-admins by Mon EOD (owner: Tom)
- Dave: upload pricebook CSV + metering names by Tue noon (owner: Dave)
- Ellen: review EULA + DPIA and flag export/data residency issues by Tue EOD (owner: Ellen)
- Cassandra: upload final logos and hero assets to artifacts by Wed COB (owner: Cassandra)
- All: confirm any third-party logos/permissions included in assets (reply here)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have the assignment. If you need a shorter sync, I'll book a 15m booth at 10:30 tomorrow. Thanks! :pray:
